# Fig set up
```{r}
if (!dir.exists("fig_rob")) dir.create("fig_rob")

figpath <- here("fig_rob/")
```

# Input data
```{r}
# REVIEW R04: The supplied SAS import creates rob_* variables, not D1-D7.
# Recover the original included-study plot-input preparation before rendering.
dat <- read_sas(paste0(here(),"/data_sas/rob_rct.sas7bdat")) %>% 
  rename (Study = study,
          Random.sequence.generation = D1,
          Allocation.concealment = D2,
          Blinding.of.participants.and.personnel = D3,
          Blinding.of.outcome.assessment = D4,
          Incomplete.outcome.data = D5,
          Selective.reporting = D6,
          Other.sources.of.bias = D7) %>%
  mutate(Overall = case_when(
            # If any domain is High → Overall High
            if_any(starts_with("Random"):starts_with("Other"), ~ .x == "High") ~ "High",
            # If none High but any Unclear → Overall Unclear
            if_any(starts_with("Random"):starts_with("Other"), ~ .x == "Unclear") ~ "Unclear",
            # If all are Low → Overall Low
            if_all(starts_with("Random"):starts_with("Other"), ~ .x == "Low") ~ "Low",
            # Fallback
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
          ), 
         Weight = 0 # Create dummy variables
         # Convert values as Unclear to No information
        # , Random.sequence.generation = ifelse(Random.sequence.generation == "Unclear", "No information", Random.sequence.generation),
        #  Allocation.concealment = ifelse(Allocation.concealment == "Unclear", "No information", Allocation.concealment),
        #  Blinding.of.participants.and.personnel = ifelse(Blinding.of.participants.and.personnel == "Unclear", "No information", Blinding.of.participants.and.personnel),
        #  Blinding.of.outcome.assessment = ifelse(Blinding.of.outcome.assessment == "Unclear", "No information", Blinding.of.outcome.assessment),
        #  Incomplete.outcome.data = ifelse(Incomplete.outcome.data == "Unclear", "No information", Incomplete.outcome.data),
        #  Selective.reporting = ifelse(Selective.reporting == "Unclear", "No information", Selective.reporting),
        #  Other.sources.of.bias = ifelse(Other.sources.of.bias == "Unclear", "No information", Other.sources.of.bias)
         ) 



```

```{r}
summary_rob <- rob_summary(data = dat[1:9], tool = "Generic", overall = FALSE, weighted = FALSE)
```


```{r, fig.width= 8, fig.height= 3.5}
summary_rob
```
```{r}
rob_save(summary_rob, paste0(figpath, "rob_summary.png"))
```

## Use ggplot to program this figure

The unclear part somehow cannot be shown in the figure, so I use the original data to plot it.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(stringr)

# Reshape and summarize
rob_data <- dat %>%
  select(Random.sequence.generation:Overall) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Domain",
    values_to = "Rating"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Domain, Rating) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Domain) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100)

# Domain column cleanup — convert dots to spaces, including "Overall" if present
domain_levels <- colnames(dat %>% select(Random.sequence.generation:Other.sources.of.bias))
domain_levels_clean <- str_replace_all(domain_levels, "\\.", " ")

# If "Overall" is in the reshaped data, handle it
if ("Overall" %in% unique(rob_data$Domain)) {
  domain_levels_clean <- c(domain_levels_clean, "Overall")
}

rob_data$Domain <- factor(
  str_replace_all(as.character(rob_data$Domain), "\\.", " "),
  levels = rev(domain_levels_clean)  # Top to bottom order
)

# Set factor levels for rating order: Low → Unclear → High
rob_data$Rating <- factor(rob_data$Rating, levels = c("High", "Unclear", "Low"))

# Define Cochrane colors
rob_colors <- c(
  "High" = "#BF0000",      # Red 
  "Unclear" = "#E2DF07",  # Yellow
  "Low" = "#02C100"      # Green
)

    #   if (colour == "colourblind") {
    #     rob_colours$low_colour <- "#fed98e"
    #     rob_colours$concerns_colour <- "#fe9929"
    #     rob_colours$high_colour <- "#d95f0e"
    #     rob_colours$ni_colour <- "#ffffff"
    #   }
    #   if (colour == "cochrane") {
    #     rob_colours$low_colour <- "#02C100"
    #     rob_colours$concerns_colour <- "#E2DF07"
    #     rob_colours$high_colour <- "#BF0000"
    #     rob_colours$ni_colour <- "#4EA1F7"
    #   }
    # }

```


```{r}
# Plot
ggplot(rob_data, aes(x = pct, y = Domain, fill = Rating)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black", width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = rob_colors,
  labels = c("High risk of bias","Unclear", "Low risk of bias"),
  name = NULL
) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = c(0.01, 0),  # adds margin on left/right side
    labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
theme(
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
  plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
  axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black"),
  axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
  legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "lines"),
  legend.key.width = unit(0.8, "lines"),
  legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white"),
  # panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"),
  plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 5, l = 10),
  legend.margin = margin(2,2,2,2, unit = "pt")
)

```


```{r}
ggsave(paste0(figpath, "rob_summary_v2.png"), width = 6.5, height = 2.5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```



# Traffic light plot
```{r}
trafficlight_rob <- rob_traffic_light(data = dat[1:9], tool = "Generic", psize = 10)
```

```{r}
rob_save(trafficlight_rob, paste0(figpath, "rob_traffic_light.png"))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(robvis)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)

```

## Split into multiple figres

```{r}
n_per_plot <- 30
n_studies <- nrow(dat)
n_plots <- ceiling(n_studies / n_per_plot)
p_size <- 6

# Sort the study by variable STUDY
dat <- dat %>%
  arrange(Study) %>%
  mutate(Study = factor(Study, levels = unique(Study)))


for (i in 1:n_plots) {
  start_row <- (i - 1) * n_per_plot + 1
  end_row <- min(i * n_per_plot, n_studies)
  dat_subset <- dat[start_row:end_row, ]

  # Create plot
  trafficlight_plot <- rob_traffic_light(data = dat_subset, tool = "Generic", psize = p_size)

  # Add title label
  title_text <- paste0(LETTERS[i], ": Risk of Bias – Studies ", start_row, " to ", end_row)
  title_grob <- textGrob(title_text, gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))

  # Combine title and plot
  combined <- arrangeGrob(title_grob, trafficlight_plot, ncol = 1, heights = c(0.05, 1))

  # Save to file
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(figpath, "rob_traffic_light_part", i, ".png"),
    plot = combined,
    width = 8,
    height = 1.2 + 0.25 * nrow(dat_subset),
    dpi = 300
  )
}

```

## Create a separate legend for each

```{r}
# Use the first batch to generate a dummy plot just for the legend
legend_plot <- rob_traffic_light(data = dat[1:5, ], tool = "Generic", psize = p_size)

# Extract and save legend
legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(figpath, "rob_legend.png"),
  plot = grid.arrange(legend_grob),
  width = 5,
  height = 1,
  dpi = 300
)

```
